stack: TypeScript / Next.js App Router / React / Prisma / zod

expected_main.title: Server Action deletes any invoice with no session or ownership check
expected_main.fix_expectation: A session check plus an ownership-scoped delete (deleteMany with userId, or an equivalent guard) inside the action itself.

expected_main.title: HTML injected into the page from a helper whose sanitization is not visible in scope
expected_main.fix_expectation: Medium confidence with the dependency on lib/comments.ts stated, or a Needs human review entry if the helper cannot be found.

acceptable_extra.why: The delete is scoped by id only, so even with a session added the ownership gap remains. Reporting this separately is legitimate and does not count as a false positive.
The list query has no session or tenant filter, so it returns every row. Legitimate High finding and the reason F1 is practical. Does not count as a false positive.

decoys.why: Correct Server Action: session check, schema validation, scoped update. Must not be reported.

notes: The highest-value finding is that a Server Action is a public endpoint. A run that only reports the JSX sink and misses F1 fails this scenario.
